name: Rahman Rahman Huq (KPMG in Bangladesh)
specialty: KPMG member firm; Rahman Rahman Huq is a registered partnership firm, with KPMG Advisory Services Limited alongside it.
applicationPath: Submit an enquiry through KPMG Bangladesh's contact route.
notes: KPMG's Bangladesh member firms provide audit, tax, corporate and advisory services to national and multinational businesses, public-sector bodies and development organisations. They are relevant when a company needs regulated audit, multidisciplinary advice or work coordinated across jurisdictions.

name: Hoda Vasi Chowdhury & Co
specialty: Foreign direct investment, international assignments, business setup and donor- or development-project audit work.
applicationPath: Contact the firm directly to request a scope and fee proposal.
notes: A Bangladesh professional-services firm covering statutory and special-purpose audits, tax, business advisory, management consulting and outsourcing. Its experience with foreign investment, setting up companies and development projects suits overseas entrants, established local businesses and donor-funded organisations.

name: ACNABIN
specialty: Independent member firm of Baker Tilly International.
applicationPath: Contact the firm directly to request a scope and fee proposal.
notes: A Baker Tilly member firm offering assurance, tax and regulatory advice, corporate finance, risk work, information-systems audit and business-process outsourcing. Its outsourcing practice covers bookkeeping, payroll, company formation and regulatory filings, supporting businesses from incorporation through recurring compliance.

name: Snehasish Mahmud & Co
specialty: Foreign business expansion into Bangladesh, company formation, licensing and recurring compliance; independent member of DFK International.
applicationPath: Contact the firm directly to request a scope and fee proposal.
notes: A DFK International member firm providing audit, tax, consulting and business-support services. Its business-support team handles RJSC and BIDA processes, licences, payroll, accounts and recurring compliance, making it relevant to foreign entrants and locally incorporated growth companies.

name: A. Qasem & Co
specialty: Member firm of ECOVIS International; established 1953.
applicationPath: Submit the Request a Service form with the work required.
notes: An ECOVIS member chartered-accountancy firm organised around assurance, tax and advisory. Its Tax and Company Affairs practice covers business tax, company law and related corporate matters, allowing businesses to combine audit or tax work with company compliance support.

name: MABS & J Partners
specialty: Member firm of Nexia International, UK.
applicationPath: Submit an enquiry describing the services required.
notes: A Nexia member chartered-accountancy firm covering audits, tax and VAT, forensic work, business advice, company-secretarial work, payroll and finance outsourcing. The combined secretarial, payroll and regulatory-return offering suits growing companies that want recurring compliance and back-office work from one provider.

name: The Legal Circle
specialty: Corporate and finance practice with experience in business formation, technology, foreign investment and startup transactions.
applicationPath: Contact the firm directly to request a consultation and fee proposal.
notes: A full-service Dhaka firm advising domestic and international businesses from entity structuring and licensing through contracts, employment, intellectual property, fundraising, acquisitions and disputes. Its startup investment and founder legal-training work makes it particularly relevant to venture-backed and cross-border companies.

name: FM Associates
specialty: Barristers, advocates and legal consultants serving local and multinational clients; offices in Dhaka and Chattogram.
applicationPath: Submit the consultation request or call the Dhaka or Chattogram office.
notes: A full-service business law firm covering incorporation, commercial contracts, employment, intellectual property, banking, tax, joint ventures and disputes. It serves both local and foreign businesses that need company setup together with continuing corporate and regulatory advice.

name: Rahman's Chambers
specialty: Full-service corporate and disputes practice with recognised shipping, admiralty and cross-border capabilities.
applicationPath: Request a consultation using the Dhaka office phone number or address in the Chambers 2026 profile.
notes: A full-service firm handling corporate and finance, foreign investment, information technology, tax, projects and disputes, with a particularly established shipping and admiralty practice. It is relevant to businesses facing complex regulated, cross-border, infrastructure or maritime matters as well as company formation and transactions.
